EN: Not a chance. You must have awful friends if you want me around.
ZH: 门都没有。你要是想要我留下，那你朋友肯定很糟糕。

EN: They might be, honestly. At least Synths will be polite when they stab you in the back.
ZH: 也许吧，说实话。至少合成人在背后捅你刀时还会彬彬有礼。

EN: Just shut up and go away.
ZH: 闭嘴滚开。

EN: We're fated to be together. Come live with us!
ZH: 我们注定在一起。来跟我们住吧！

EN: Isn't the Brotherhood worse than Synths?
ZH: 兄弟会难道不比合成人更坏吗？

EN: Yes, I'm a prisoner. I think they thought I was really weird for hanging out with Radscorpions.
ZH: 没错，我是囚犯。我想他们觉得我跟辐射蝎混在一起太怪了。

EN: You have an annoying look on your face, like you're here to rescue me.
ZH: 你脸上带着一副烦人的表情，像要救我出去似的。

EN: And you're rescuing other Synths. You're not even trying to hide it anymore.
ZH: 而且你还在救别的合成人。你连装都不装了。

EN: Vault Dwellers. You're so passionate about “Synth rights”, and you don't even understand.
ZH: 避难所居民。你们对“合成人权利”如此热衷，却根本不懂。

EN: Too bad you won't live to tell your Overseer!
ZH: 可惜你活不到回去向你监督者汇报的那天了！

EN: They will eat you from the inside out!
ZH: 它们会从里到外把你啃掉！

EN: You're just proving my point. They are too dangerous! And so are you!
ZH: 你正好证明了我说得对。它们太危险了！你们也是！

EN: Are you saying there are Synths in our Vault?
ZH: 你是说我们避难所里有合成人？

EN: We'll deal with the Institute. After this.
ZH: 我们会对付学院的。这事之后再说。

EN: Synths have human DNA, so that wouldn't even work.
ZH: 合成人有人的DNA，所以那套根本行不通。

EN: When's the last time you did a DNA test of everyone in your Vault?
ZH: 你上次给避难所里所有人做DNA测试是什么时候？

EN: If you did, you'd realize the Institute is far more clever than you are.
ZH: 要是做了，你就会明白学院比你聪明得多。

EN: There they are! Get them!
ZH: 他们在那儿！抓住他们！

EN: No one makes a fool of the Brotherhood!
ZH: 没人能耍弄兄弟会！

EN: The Brotherhood did us dirty. Now it's time for some real payback. We've lured Elder Maxson and his entourage into a trap, ready for you to spring.
ZH: 兄弟会坑了我们。现在该好好回敬他们了。我们已经把麦克森长老和他的随从引入陷阱，就等你们来收网了。

EN: Steelhead Fishing
ZH: 钓钢鳟

EN: Find Arthur Maxson
ZH: 找到亚瑟·麦克森

EN: Deal with Elder Maxson, who fell into our trap.
ZH: 对付落入我们陷阱的麦克森长老。

EN: Hey, we did it!
ZH: 嘿，我们做到了！

EN: Feels like every time there's a trap, we're the ones walking into it.
ZH: 感觉每次设陷阱，走进去的都是我们自己。

EN: But now, the Brotherhood is in OUR trap.
ZH: 但现在，是兄弟会进了我们的陷阱。

EN: What a time to be alive. Let's show Maxson what we're made of.
ZH: 这年头可真是好时节。让麦克森见识见识我们的本事。

EN: Vault Dwellers? Are you with the Synths that were supposed to be in the building?
ZH: 避难所居民？你们跟那些本该在这栋楼里的合成人是一伙的？

EN: Augh! We've been duped!
ZH: 啊！我们被骗了！

EN: There are no Synths, fool. This is a trap!
ZH: 哪有什么合成人，蠢货。这是个陷阱！

EN: I can't believe we fell for this stupid trap!
ZH: 真不敢相信我们竟上了这个蠢陷阱的当！

EN: That's just what they want you to think!
ZH: 这正是他们想让你这么想的！

EN: You're not gonna kick mine!
ZH: 你休想踢我的屁股！

EN: Keep your dirty science to yourself!
ZH: 把你那肮脏的科学留给自己吧！

EN: Synths are just like us. Didn't ask to be here.
ZH: 合成人跟我们一样。没谁是自己想来的。

EN: I'm not here to understand. I'm here to kick butt.
ZH: 我不是来理解的。我是来揍人的。

EN: As a scientist, I'm offended by your ignorance.
ZH: 作为一名科学家，我对你的无知感到愤慨。

EN: And you… helping Synths, getting involved with those Railroad idiots…
ZH: 而你们……帮助合成人，跟那些铁路白痴搅在一起……

EN: You don't understand the Synths! They're like ticking time bombs!
ZH: 你们不了解合成人！它们就像定时炸弹！

EN: And they're all going to explode at once! All over the Commonwealth!
ZH: 而且它们会同时引爆！遍布整个联邦！

EN: What's going on? Why is the Brotherhood of Steel attacking our town?
ZH: 怎么回事？钢铁兄弟会为什么要袭击我们的镇子？

EN: Well, it's not! Yeesh. I hope you're going to clean up after yourselves.
ZH: 呃，这儿可没废弃！啧。希望你们能收拾好自己留下的烂摊子。

EN: Real mercenary, aren't you? I suppose I should say thanks…
ZH: 可真够雇佣兵的。我想我该说声谢谢……

EN: S-Synths? Here? What would a Synth be doing here? Here, take this and forget you saw me.
ZH: 合，合成人？在这儿？合成人来这儿干什么？给，拿着这个，就当没见过我。

EN: That's our fault. Thought it was abandoned.
ZH: 那是我们的错。以为这地方废弃了。

EN: I don't know, but we're stopping them. Pay up.
ZH: 我不知道，但我们在阻止他们。拿钱来。

EN: They're probably looking for Synths.
ZH: 他们大概在找合成人。

EN: So, the Institute really has got their claws in you.
ZH: 看来学院真的把你们攥在手里了。

EN: For all you know, I could be a Synth. Then who are you serving?
ZH: 说不定，我就可能是合成人。那你效忠的又是谁？

EN: Your gut is hopeless. What about me? Do you think I'm a Synth?
ZH: 你的直觉不可救药。那我呢？你觉得我是合成人吗？

EN: Of course. They're so convincing, even I could be a Synth!
ZH: 那当然。它们装得太像了，连我都可能是合成人！

EN: You are so eager to make enemies. And here's the price.
ZH: 你太急于树敌了。这就是代价。

EN: Hey, I'm just going with my gut.
ZH: 嘿，我只是凭直觉行事。

EN: Actually, Synths are pretty warm.
ZH: 其实，合成人还挺温暖的。

EN: And from your faces, I can see you don't even know it yet.
ZH: 而且从你们的脸上我能看出，你们还不知道这件事。

EN: Some of you have been replaced by cold, cruel machines. Maybe even you.
ZH: 你们中的一些人已经被冰冷残忍的机器替换了。甚至可能是你。

EN: Before you know it, there will be no humans left in the Commonwealth.
ZH: 用不了多久，联邦就不会再有真正的人类了。

EN: And it will be because of you.
ZH: 而那都是因为你们。

EN: Betrayal of Steel
ZH: 钢铁背叛

EN: Of course it's a Mole rat broodmother on the loose! Just our luck.
ZH: 果然，跑出来的是一只鼹鼠育母！我们真是够倒霉的。

EN: The Institute has reached out with a ceasefire and seeks a parley. Can there be peace between us?
ZH: 学院主动提出停火，想和谈。我们之间能有和平吗？

EN: Truce
ZH: 停战

EN: Meet with the Institute leaders
ZH: 与学院领导层会面

EN: Attend to a science project
ZH: 照料一个科学项目

EN: Find an escaped creature
ZH: 找到一只逃跑的生物

EN: The Institute wants to parley. We want a truce.
ZH: 学院想和谈。我们想要停战。

EN: Welcome to the Institute.
ZH: 欢迎来到学院。

EN: We are unarmed as a sign of faith. If we thought you cruel, we wouldn't have invited you.
ZH: 我们徒手赴会，以示诚意。如果我们觉得你们残忍，就不会邀请你们了。

EN: Glad to hear it. Please enjoy your visit.
ZH: 很高兴听你这么说。请尽情参观。

EN: As you should. Blood was spilled on both sides. Starting anew will take mending.
ZH: 理应如此。双方都流过血。重新开始，得慢慢弥合。

EN: Hopefully you prove trustworthy, or we might start shooting.
ZH: 希望你们值得信任，否则我们可要开火了。

EN: Our hearts long for peace as well. That is why we came in good faith.
ZH: 我们内心也渴望和平。所以我们才怀着诚意前来。

EN: You piqued our curiousity. Still, we reserve judgment... for now.
ZH: 你们勾起了我们的好奇。不过，我们暂不表态……至少眼下是。

EN: Thank you for accepting the truce.
ZH: 感谢你们接受停战。

EN: We chose this place, one of our earliest research sites, to showcase who we are.
ZH: 我们选择了这里——我们最早的研究据点之一，来向你们展示我们的真实面貌。

EN: We hope this shared understanding leads to lasting peace.
ZH: 我们希望这种相互理解能带来持久的和平。

EN: Feel free to wander and meet the staff. Our leader awaits deeper inside.
ZH: 请随意走走，见见我们的工作人员。我们的首领在更深处等候。

EN: Ah, the visitors! Always nice to see new faces.
ZH: 啊，访客们！见到新面孔总是让人高兴。

EN: I had a feeling. I wrapped them in a proper welcome basket for you.
ZH: 我就知道。已经把它们包进一份像样的欢迎礼篮了。

EN: Now you're speaking my language. Nothing beats a good pew-pew.
ZH: 这下你终于说到点子上了。没有什么比得上一阵噼噼啪啪的枪声。

EN: Already printing the schematics.
ZH: 已经开始打印图纸了。

EN: <Nervous laugh> People might start thinking you're a Synth...
ZH: <紧张地笑> 人们怕是要以为你是合成人了……

EN: You already know what we want: more Fusion Cores.
ZH: 你已经知道我们要什么：更多聚变核心。

EN: For peace to last, we need equal strength. Weapons.
ZH: 要让和平持久，我们需要对等的武力。武器。

EN: You're a bunch of scientists, right? Maybe share some technology.
ZH: 你们是一群科学家，对吧？分享点技术吧。

EN: I like what you're wearing. Got extras lying around?
ZH: 我喜欢你穿的衣服。还有多余的吗？

EN: This room may not look like it, but it's a store.
ZH: 这房间看着不像，但它是个商店。

EN: Your Overseer already arranged payment.
ZH: 你们的监督者已经安排好付款了。

EN: So go ahead, take your pick.
ZH: 所以，请自便，随便挑。

EN: I'm so excited to meet Vault Dwellers. Allow me to show you my experiment!
ZH: 能见到避难所居民，我太兴奋了！请允许我展示一下我的实验！

EN: Oh! No fun at all. I wouldn't hurt you. Not permanently, at least.
ZH: 哦！真没劲。我不会伤害你的。至少不会造成永久伤害。

EN: Here we go... ... ... Fascinating data. Months of analysis ahead. Here, for the trouble.
ZH: 这就开始啦……这数据妙极了。接下来几个月有得分析了。给，这是你的辛苦费。

EN: I'm not. No one believes in my work. Any chance you do? No? Bummer.
ZH: 我才不是呢。没人相信我的研究。你有哪怕一丝可能相信我吗？没有？真扫兴。

EN: But science waits for no man! Oh, alright. I can be patient. ... ... How about now?
ZH: 但科学不等人！噢，好吧。我可以保持耐心。……那现在可以了吗？

EN: Try it and die.
ZH: 试试看你就死定了。

EN: Sure, go ahead!
ZH: 好啊，请便！

EN: You don't sound like your typical Institute scientist.
ZH: 你听起来不像典型的学院科学家。

EN: Too soon, friend.. We can't trust you yet.
ZH: 还太早，朋友……我们还没法信任你们。

EN: My neutrino bombardment mega-grid lacing is ready. Invisible. Harmless.
ZH: 我的中微子轰击巨型网格编织层已经准备好了。看不见，也无害。

EN: Using it on you will show exactly by how much radiation has shortened your lifespan.
ZH: 在你身上用一下，就能精确显示辐射让你的寿命缩短了多少。

EN: Just hold still...
ZH: 站好别动……

EN: Good timing. Your presence, I mean.
ZH: 来得正好。我是说，你们能来真是太好了。

EN: Thank you. Our research could one day restore the whole wide world.
ZH: 谢谢。我们的研究有朝一日或许能修复整个世界。

EN: I see. You're the nonchalant type. Let's hope no one gets eaten.
ZH: 我明白了。你们是那种漫不经心的人。但愿没人被吃掉。

EN: I didn't expect a mess. My apologies. You still use Caps, right? Perhaps this helps?
ZH: 我可没料到会出乱子。抱歉。你们还用瓶盖，对吧？也许这个能帮上忙？

EN: In the spirit of our budding friendship, I'll help.
ZH: 本着我们这份刚萌芽的友谊，我来帮忙。

EN: Hmph. If we feel like it.
ZH: 哼。要是我们乐意的话。

EN: We're not here to clean up your mess.
ZH: 我们不是来收拾你的烂摊子的。

EN: Well... good might be overstating it.
ZH: 嗯……说好可能过头了。

EN: I was meant to show our work restoring local fauna, but our test subject escaped.
ZH: 我本想展示我们复原本地野生动物的工作，但试验体跑了。

EN: It was pregnant, so if you could... retrieve the body at least? We were told not to carry weapons.
ZH: 它怀了孕，所以如果你能……至少把尸体带回来？我们被告知不能带武器。

EN: Visitors! Hi! I manage our communications arrays.
ZH: 访客！嗨！我负责管理我们的通讯阵列。

EN: Possible. They proved more capable than I expected for non-Institute folks.
ZH: 有可能。对于非学院的人来说，他们表现出的能力超出了我的预期。

EN: Ah! Very funny. So you truly don't know either...
ZH: 啊！真有趣。所以你们其实也不知道……

EN: No implication intended. Ironically, communication isn't my strength. We'll figure it out.
ZH: 没有暗示你的意思。讽刺的是，沟通恰恰不是我的强项。我们会查清楚的。

EN: Maybe the Brotherhood returned the favor after you sabotaged their array.
ZH: 也许是兄弟会在你们破坏他们的阵列后，以牙还牙。

EN: That's how dangerous we are. Tread carefully.
ZH: 我们就是这么危险。你们最好小心点。

EN: I'm not sure I like your implication.
ZH: 我不太喜欢你的暗示。

EN: I'll spare you the technobabble, but it's among the most advanced tech out there.
ZH: 我就不跟你讲那些科技黑话了，总之这是世上最先进的科技之一。

EN: It's securely encrypted. So only us with our codes can use it.
ZH: 它经过了严密加密，所以只有持有我们代码的人才能使用。

EN: It has its limit. Lately, we've lost contact with many field units.
ZH: 它也有局限。最近，我们跟许多外勤单位失去了联系。

EN: You wouldn't know anything about that, would you?
ZH: 这件事，你们该不会知道些什么吧？

EN: I can't shake the feeling that this is all staged for us.
ZH: 我总觉得这一切都是为我们布置的。

EN: Are we really going to trust their word?
ZH: 我们真的打算相信他们的话吗？

EN: Then again... this may be our last chance at peace.
ZH: 话又说回来……这也许是我们最后的和平机会。

EN: Representative of the Overseer, it's a pleasure to meet you.
ZH: 监督者的代表，见到你很高兴。

EN: Excellent. I hope we meet again to forge a more permanent accord.
ZH: 太好了。希望我们能再见面，缔结一份更持久的协定。

EN: I hope this seed of trust grows to blossom into a profound friendship.
ZH: 我希望这颗信任的种子能发芽，绽放出深厚的友谊。

EN: I'd be inclined to say the same, but in a more diplomatic way. So be it.
ZH: 我也想说同样的话，只是措辞会更客套些。那就这样吧。

EN: We'll sign. Time will tell if it holds.
ZH: 我们会签约。时间会证明它能否维系。

EN: The tour did not impress. But at least you didn't try to kill us.
ZH: 这次参观没让我印象深刻。但至少你们没试图杀我们。

EN: I do not like you. I'm only signing because the Overseer orders it.
ZH: 我不喜欢你们。我签约只是因为监督者下令。

EN: This deal is void the minute you guys get in our way. Remember that.
ZH: 一旦你们挡了我们的道，这份协议立刻作废。记住这一点。

EN: How was your tour? Not our most advanced site, but my favorite.
ZH: 你们的参观怎么样？这里不是我们最先进的据点，但却是我的最爱。

EN: To business: I propose a treaty of de-escalation, if you agree.
ZH: 说正事：我提议缔结一项缓和冲突的条约，如果你们同意的话。

EN: A foundation for a future without violence between us.
ZH: 为我们之间无暴力的未来奠定基础。

EN: Along with it, we offer our best resources.
ZH: 随条约一并奉上我们最好的资源。

EN: Ghouls? The rads made their way to the Institute in the end!
ZH: 尸鬼？辐射终究还是渗进了学院！

EN: To test the Institute's claim of peace, we're sending a team to an abandoned lab to tap their comms network.
ZH: 为了检验学院关于和平的说法，我们派一支队伍前往一座废弃实验室，窃听他们的通讯网络。

EN: Fake Out
ZH: 虚晃一枪

EN: Find the communication codes.
ZH: 找到通讯代码。

EN: We can access the Institute's communications from an abandoned lab.
ZH: 我们可以在废弃实验室里接入学院的通讯。

EN: As much as the Overseer wants peace with the Institute, we need guarantees.
ZH: 无论监督者多想与学院讲和，我们都需要保障。

EN: Our allies said this place has the code to let us listen in on Synth-maker chatter.
ZH: 我们的盟友说这地方有代码，能让我们窃听合成人制造者的通话。

EN: If they're trying to snow us, we'll know.
ZH: 如果他们想糊弄我们，我们会知道的。

EN: <Scrambled Noises>
ZH: <受干扰的杂音>

EN: What's wrong with those tin men? Left behind to rust, like the rest of this place? Looks like they still have some fight left.
ZH: 那些铁皮人怎么了？被丢在这儿生锈，跟这地方的其他东西一样？看来它们还有几分战斗力。

EN: Oh! This is awkward. Guess my secret getaway spot's blown.
ZH: 哦！真尴尬。看来我的秘密藏身处暴露了。

EN: I thought you were the good guys!
ZH: 我还以为你们是好人！

EN: I suppose I should thank you, whoever you are.
ZH: 我想我该谢谢你们，不管你们是谁。

EN: Well, I was thinking of defecting so that works.
ZH: 嗯，我正考虑叛逃，所以这样也行。

EN: Are you the real Liam? No, you can't be. I… I have to end you.
ZH: 你是真正的利亚姆吗？不，你不可能是。我……我必须终结你。

EN: Let's just forget we saw each other. Get out of here. No need for violence.
ZH: 就当咱俩没见过。离开这里。不必动武。

EN: Is the Institute messing with us? Two Liams? You're coming with us so we can keep an eye on you.
ZH: 学院在耍我们？两个利亚姆？你得跟我们走，让我们盯着你。

EN: Why are you here? I'm really confused by what I'm seeing now.
ZH: 你们怎么会在这儿？我现在看到的一切真让我摸不着头脑。

EN: Here's the communications terminal.
ZH: 通讯终端在这儿。

EN: Let's mastermind the password…
ZH: 我们来破解密码……

EN: Jackpot. With these codes, we can access the logs between coursers and leadership.
ZH: 中奖了。有了这些代码，我们就能访问追猎者和领导层之间的日志。

EN: No history, but it's better than nothing. Now they can't ambush us anymore.
ZH: 没有历史记录，但总比没有强。现在他们再也无法偷袭我们了。

EN: A straightfoward mission with just a touch of weirdness, just how I like it.
ZH: 一场直截了当的任务，只是掺了那么一点点古怪，正合我口味。

EN: An Institute splinter group has intel for us. All they want in return is chemistry equipment.
ZH: 一个学院分裂组织有情报给我们。他们只想要化学设备作为回报。

EN: Fratboys of Technology
ZH: 技术兄弟会

EN: Crash the party
ZH: 闯入派对

EN: Institute defectors have intel for us.
ZH: 学院叛逃者有情报给我们。

EN: Hey, man, you came to our shindig! I mean, conference!
ZH: 嘿，老兄，你来参加我们的聚会了！我是说，会议！

EN: Nah. But we've got lots of these things, just in case...
ZH: 没。但我们有很多这些东西，以防万一……

EN: Hey, hey, we're adult, okay? You're not my mom.  Just get in, okay.
ZH: 嘿，嘿，我们都是成年人了，好吗？你不是我妈。就进来吧，行。

EN: Nah, those are stiff and itchy. This is costume wear… celebration-style. Hey, you need one.
ZH: 不，那些又硬又痒。这是戏服……庆祝款。嘿，你也得来一件。

EN: Booze or chems? You look like you're about to get sick.
ZH: 酒还是药物？你看起来快要吐了。

EN: Teens! This splinter group is made of teens!
ZH: 少年！这分裂组织是一群少年组成的！

EN: What's with the outfits? Not very Institute-like.
ZH: 你们这身打扮怎么回事？不像学院的风格。

EN: Okay, listen, dudes. We might've celebrated a little too hard. 'Cause of you, yeah.
ZH: 好了，听着，伙计们。我们可能庆祝得太嗨了。还都是因为你们，没错。

EN: Don't mind us.
ZH: 别管我们。

EN: President What's-his-name is inside somewhere.
ZH: 那个叫什么名字的会长就在里面的某个地方。

EN: I'm starting to think coming here was a bad idea.
ZH: 我开始觉得来这儿是个坏主意了。

EN: Maybe they got kicked out of the Institute.
ZH: 也许他们是被学院赶出来的。

EN: And for good reason, from what I see.
ZH: 而且照我看，被赶出来也是活该。

EN: Still, let's stay hopeful. Maybe we just had to go through the rowdy bunch.
ZH: 不过，还是抱点希望吧。也许只是得先闯过这帮吵闹家伙这一关。

EN: Welcome, Vault Dwellers.
ZH: 欢迎，避难所居民。

EN: Ah man, that's uncalled for. You never roleplay? You're boring.
ZH: 哦，兄弟，这可不合适。你从不角色扮演吗？你真无聊。
